items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: Joe Garland asked me, 'You've been here before with Jeter-Pillars, do you know a good bass player in town? We need a bass player right away.'

ctx.x: Who was the subleader there, Ed Mullens or was it Teddy McRae?

When I first joined the band it was Teddy McRae and then Teddy had something else there to do and then Joe Garland took over. It was Joe Garland who is on these records, Joe Garland supervised that recording session. Louie was just there to just play his parts and soloed; but Joe Garland was in charge of the band then.
Arvell Shaw was on those sessions. This is, of course, 1946 and what kind of relationship did you have with Arvell?
